expect_red: ...and it sits to the panel's RIGHT, which is what 'beside' means

mutations.contract: The page yields ENOUGH room, not just some: the whole DAG drawing ends up clear of the panel, never partly under it.
mutations.note: The discriminating witness for the 2026-09-16 review blocker. The shipped guard measured PARTIAL overlap against the drawing's SCROLLPORT (dag.right - max(dag.left, panel.right) >= reserve) and so was green over a diagram that was 100% covered: `#topopane` is 738px wide and only its left end was under the panel. This mutation shifts the page 300px SHORT -- the nav rail's own width, the obvious off-by-one -- which leaves the scrollport partly clear and the drawing wholly underneath. The old formula passes that; "the drawing's left edge is at or past the panel's right edge" does not. Its sibling `flyout-open-yields-the-page` mutates the same declaration to no shift at all, which is the pre-review build; this one is the near miss that looks correct.
